description.text:
Your bigger, better Bupa Health and Dental Centre is here, a flagship Health and Dental Centre at Crossrail Place in the heart of Canary Wharf.

Your new centre is purpose-built with the latest facilities and clinical equipment offering extended opening hours and a wide range of services to better suit your busy lifestyle, including:

- general, cosmetic and specialist dentistry
- private GP appointments
- travel and flu vaccinations
- health and fitness assessments
- physiotherapy and sports physicians

Everyone's welcome - you don't need to have Bupa health insurance to use our services.

*Calls may be recorded and may be monitored. Bupa Health Assessments, GP Services, Musculoskeletal Services, Dermatology and Cosmetic Services are provided by Bupa Occupational Health Limited. Registered in England and Wales No. 631336. Registered Office: Bupa House, 15-19 Bloomsbury Way, London, WC1A 2BA. Bupa Dental Services are provided by Bupa Dental Services Limited. Registered Office: Bupa House, 15-19 Bloomsbury Way, London, WC1A 2BA. Registered No. 479557. Travel Health Services are provided by MASTA Limited. Registered in England and Wales No. 01830630.
